definition.name: Check host accept factory admission and physical retirement

steps.name: Run exact source-bound ownership controls
steps.run:
python3 -m pip install --requirement tools/requirements.lock
python3 -B -m unittest tools.tests.test_host_accept_factory_owner -v
timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=10s 2400s python3 -B tools/qualify_host_accept_factory.py --source-commit "${{ github.sha }}" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/host-accept-factory"

with.name: host-accept-factory-${{ github.sha }}
with.path:
${{ runner.temp }}/host-accept-factory/receipt.json
${{ runner.temp }}/host-accept-factory/FAILED.json
${{ runner.temp }}/host-accept-factory/source-inputs.json
${{ runner.temp }}/host-accept-factory/commands.json
${{ runner.temp }}/host-accept-factory/commands/logs/*.txt
${{ runner.temp }}/host-accept-factory/fixtures/native-stream-outers.wasm

reviewReason: Retain bounded original-budget and private ownership controls at the exact source.
